# Deutsche Welle (DW)

> > International news and analysis from Germany's public broadcaster, covering geopolitics, climate, human rights, and global conflicts.

Deutsche Welle provides comprehensive German-language journalism on world events, with particular focus on European perspectives on international relations, Middle East conflicts, climate policy, and social justice issues. The coverage emphasizes diplomatic developments, humanitarian crises, and cultural stories from around the globe.

## Key Topics

- Iran-Krieg
- Nahost-Konflikt
- Geopolitik
- Donald Trump
- Friedrich Merz
- Israel
- Hamas
- Klimawandel
- Pariser Abkommen
- Ukraine-Krieg
- Deutschland
- USA
- Gazastreifen
- Erneuerbare Energien
- Transatlantische Beziehungen
